name: Open Chest
description: Rubble has spilled across half the floor, and a grey haze of stone dust still hangs in the torchlight. A cracked oak chest sits crooked on top of the pile, its iron bands flecked with rust. Whoever carried it this far didn't carry it any further.
descriptionVariants: Water drips somewhere behind a collapsed beam, slow and even, and the timber smells of rot and wet iron. Wedged beneath it is a rusted lockbox, its lid swollen with damp. The key is still in the lock, snapped off at the shaft.

The corridor narrows here, and the floor is swept clean in a square the width of a sleeping mat. Someone stacked their gear in the middle of it before they stopped needing it: boots with the laces tucked in, a belt coiled flat, a pack still buckled shut.
chainEscalatedDescription: A chest sits in the rubble. The pry bar you carry for these has gone blunt at the tip.

name: Guardian Fight
description: The torch reaches only halfway across this room; the rest is a black that smells of musk and wet fur. A chest sits in the far corner. Beside it, a closed spiral is scratched into the wall, and somewhere past the light, claws scrape slowly on stone. The scraping stops.
descriptionVariants: The air is warm here, warmer than it should be, and thick with an animal smell. Something breathes in the dark ahead, deep and slow, a sound that comes up through the floor as much as through the air. It keeps the same pace whether you move or not.

Grit crunches under your boots, loud in a room this quiet, and the walls are scored at knee height with long pale gouges. Back where the light doesn't reach, loose stone shifts under something heavy, and dust sifts down into the torchlight. The shifting stops when you stop.
chainBuildupDescription: Claws scrape on stone in the dark corner, then once more, a stride nearer the door.
chainForcedDescription: It is standing in the doorway you came in through.
chainForced2Description: The scraping starts while you're still on the stairs.
chainForced3Description: Claw marks run from the corner to the foot of the stairs, worn deep, back and forth.

crossEventVariants.description: The torch reaches only halfway across this room; the rest is a black that smells of musk and wet fur. A chest sits in the far corner. Beside it, a closed spiral is scratched into the wall, and somewhere past the light, claws scrape slowly on stone. The spiral on the artifact in your pack turns the other way.

reflection.prompt: The guardian's ashes smell of incense.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: You came down the stairs with your weapon drawn.
reflection.escalated2Prompt: Someone is cleaning their blade before the ash has settled.
reflection.escalated3Prompt: You walk through the ash on the way out without slowing.

options.curious: You pinch up some of the ash and smell it again.
options.wary: You knock the ash off your boots before going on.
options.dismissive: You kick the ash off the chest lid and open it.

name: Merchant Encounter
description: A lamp gutters on the stone, smelling of oil, over a cloth spread with goods, each with a spiral mark burned into it. A hooded figure bows.
descriptionVariants: Firelight catches on a buckle, a cup, a ring, a knife with no edge, each marked the same way. A hooded shape reaches for the first.
A cloth lies on the stone, a pebble on each corner against a draft that isn't there. The hooded figure keeps its head bowed over the goods.

crossEventVariants.description: A lamp gutters over a cloth of goods, each with a spiral mark. A hooded figure bows. The cloth is the weave of the strip grown into that wall.

returnDescription: A hooded figure bows over a cloth of new wares, its hands folded at the same height, the bow dipping to the same depth.

reflection.prompt: The hooded figure never once lifted the hood, not even to count your coin.

options.curious: You look into the dark under the hood for a face until the bow is over.
options.wary: Your eyes stay off the hood the whole time.
options.dismissive: You pack the wares away before the lamp is out of sight.

name: Desecrate the Altar
description: The room is lit from one place only: a stone altar giving off a pale red light that rises and falls, slow as breathing. The glow stains the walls the colour of a healing burn. A spiral is cut into the base, closed like a knot.
descriptionVariants: No torch is needed in here. A pulse of red light runs along the altar's edge, and the stone ticks faintly as it warms and cools, like a pot left by a fire. Water stands in every crack in the floor except the ones nearest the altar.
Dust hangs thick in the red light around the altar. The glow pools in a carved spiral at its base, sealed shut, the cuts older than the stone around them. Your torch hisses in the heat.
chainBuildupDescription: The stone altar glows with a pale red light, pulsing quicker than a resting heart.
chainForcedDescription: The red light has spread across the floor to the doorway. There is no stepping around it.
chainForced2Description: The glow had reached the doorframe by the time you came in.
chainForced3Description: The spiral at the altar's base has been scored through with a blade, more than once. The cuts look like yours.

crossEventVariants.description: The room is lit from one place only: a stone altar giving off a pale red light that rises and falls, slow as breathing. Someone in the party wipes their palms dry before going closer.

reflection.prompt: The glow is still there, faint, where your hand was.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: You stepped into the red light without testing it first.
reflection.escalated2Prompt: Your hands smell of scorched stone. You wipe them on your trousers and keep going.
reflection.escalated3Prompt: The altar goes dark behind you. The stone dust in your blade's edge has packed into the old nicks.

options.curious: You trace the closed spiral with a finger before you leave.
options.wary: You keep your hands well away from the base on the way past.
options.dismissive: You turn your back on the glow and check the way down.

name: Blood Altar
description: A copper smell fills the room before the torchlight finds the pedestal. Worn carvings run down its sides and ooze a dark, still-warm liquid, a spiral unwound and open at its center. The liquid creeps along every channel toward one cup and stops a finger's width short of it.
chainEscalatedDescription: Carvings on the pedestal ooze toward the cup. Someone has the knife out and the bandage ready.
chainEscalated2Description: The liquid stops a finger's width short of the cup. The palm held out over it is more scar than skin.
chainEscalated3Description: The liquid creeps toward the cup. Three of you have a scar in the same place on the left palm.

crossEventVariants.description: A copper smell fills the room before the torchlight finds the pedestal. Worn carvings run down its sides and ooze a dark, still-warm liquid, a spiral unwound and open at its center. Someone's knife is out, and someone else has a hand on their wrist.

A copper smell fills the room before the torchlight finds the pedestal. Worn carvings run down its sides and ooze a dark, still-warm liquid, a spiral unwound and open at its center. Two of you roll up a sleeve at the same time.

reflection.prompt: The cut closes before the bandage is tied. It is the length of a finger joint, neat as a ruler mark.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: The cut went where the last one did.
reflection.escalated2Prompt: The cut is the same length as the others, to the hair.
reflection.escalated3Prompt: There's a callus now where the cuts go.

options.curious: You hold the cut up to the light and measure it against a finger joint.
options.wary: You wrap the cut tight and keep the hand inside your coat.
options.dismissive: You flex the hand twice and pick up your pack.

name: Cursed Shrine
description: Candle stubs ring the base of a statue, long cold, their wax gone grey with dust. The statue has three eyes carved one above the other, and the stone around them is smooth from touching. One of them is open. It wasn't the same one a moment ago.

crossEventVariants.description: Candle stubs ring the base of a statue, long cold, their wax gone grey with dust. The statue has three eyes carved one above the other, and the stone around them is smooth from touching. One of them is open. Its lowest lid is chipped, the way stone chips under a knife point.

reflection.prompt: From the doorway, you can still see which eye is open.

options.curious: You count the shut eyes again on your way out.
options.wary: You keep the statue at the edge of your sight until the corridor bends.
options.dismissive: It's carved stone. You turn your back on it.

name: Twin Altars
description: Two stone pedestals face each other across a narrow room, close enough that a person standing between them could touch both. Each is carved with a spiral, open at the center, and the air between them is a little colder than the air around. A hairline crack already runs across the floor between them.

crossEventVariants.description: Two stone pedestals face each other across a narrow room, close enough that a person standing between them could touch both. Each is carved with a spiral, open at the center, and the air between them is a little colder than the air around. The cups set into them are dark at the bottom, the same dark as at the last altar.

reflection.prompt: Dust from the broken pedestal is still settling on your boots.

options.curious: You pocket a chip of the broken one.
options.wary: You don't go back to look at the other pedestal.
options.dismissive: You step over the pieces without looking down.

name: Ritual Circle
description: The floor here was swept once, carefully, and the broom marks are still in the dust. In the middle, old dried blood traces a spiral across the stone, open at one end, its line as even as a drawn string. The broom marks stop a full stride short of it on every side.
chainEscalatedDescription: Old dried blood traces a spiral across the stone. Your packs come off at its open end, the way they do at camp.
chainEscalated2Description: Old dried blood traces a spiral across the stone. At its open end the floor is worn smooth in two places, a pair of knees apart.
chainEscalated3Description: Old dried blood traces a spiral across the stone. The worn places at its open end fit your knees exactly.

crossEventVariants.description: The floor here was swept once, carefully, and the broom marks are still in the dust. In the middle, old dried blood traces a spiral across the stone, open at one end, its line as even as a drawn string. The broom marks stop a full stride short of it on every side. The blood is the same dark brown as the stain on your sleeve cuff.

reflection.prompt: The circle goes quiet. The gap at its open end is the width of a hand.
reflection.escalatedPrompt: Your knee finds the worn spot in front of the circle.
reflection.escalated2Prompt: You set the offering down on the pale square the last one left in the dust, edge to edge.
reflection.escalated3Prompt: On the way out, someone asks how many that makes. Two of you give different numbers.

options.curious: You set your hand in the gap. It fits.
options.wary: You mark the room on your map as one to avoid.
options.dismissive: You weigh the new artifact in your hand and stow it.

name: Wandering Gambling Den
description: Lamplight and the smell of cheap tallow gather around an upturned crate. A stranger shuffles three cups across its top, worn pale in a circle by the same motion, his forearms bare and unmarked. The cups click together, quick and even. 'Put it on the crate. I want to see your face when the cup comes up.'

crossEventVariants.description: Lamplight and the smell of cheap tallow gather around an upturned crate. A stranger shuffles three cups across its top, worn pale in a circle by the same motion, his forearms bare and unmarked. The cups click together, quick and even. He asks what you've already paid today, and starts the next round before you answer.

returnDescription.won: The stranger sets the three cups mouth-down without looking up. 'Didn't expect a winner to come back for more.'
returnDescription.lost: The stranger sets the three cups mouth-down without looking up. 'Back for more? I like watching the same face lose twice.'
returnDescription.declined: The stranger sets the three cups mouth-down without looking up. 'Changed your mind? Show me the face that walked away.'

reflection.prompt: Behind you, the cups start clicking again.

options.curious: You watch his hands through two more rounds, trying to follow the right cup.
options.wary: You keep a hand on your purse until the clicking fades.
options.dismissive: You count what's left in your purse and walk on.

name: Wandering Hermit
description: Rubble has been pushed back to the walls to clear a patch of floor, and an old man sits cross-legged in the middle of it, a spiral mark scarred into his forearm. His eyes are shut. Beside him a small fire of sticks burns without smoke. 'Put down what you want rid of. I'll name the price.'

crossEventVariants.description: Rubble has been pushed back to the walls to clear a patch of floor, and an old man sits cross-legged in the middle of it, a spiral mark scarred into his forearm. His eyes are open when you arrive. He lays a clean rag on the stone beside him before you've said a word.

Rubble has been pushed back to the walls to clear a patch of floor, and an old man sits cross-legged in the middle of it, a spiral mark scarred into his forearm. His eyes go to the guardian ash on your boots, then to the mark on his own arm.

Rubble has been pushed back to the walls to clear a patch of floor, and an old man sits cross-legged in the middle of it, a spiral mark scarred into his forearm. He looks at your hands before your face, and keeps looking at them while you talk.

returnDescription: The old man has cleared a space on the stone in front of him. 'Back again. Set it down where I can see it.'
campReflectionUnawareEcho: He shuts his eyes for the trade before you've set anything down.

stanceEcho.curious: He watches you a little longer than he needs to before naming his price.
stanceEcho.wary: He names his price, then keeps his own hands where you can see them.
stanceEcho.dismissive: He shrugs and names his price before you've finished talking.

reflection.prompt: His eyes stayed shut for the whole trade. His hands never missed the coins.

options.curious: You look at the mark on his forearm until he turns the arm over.
options.wary: You keep the talk to the price and nothing else.
options.dismissive: You tuck the coins away and pick up the pace.

name: Collapsed Floor
description: Cold air rises from a section of floor that has dropped away along a long crack, and with it a smell of wet earth and lamp oil. Loose grit still trickles over the edge and ticks against something far below. A weak groan comes up after it.

crossEventVariants.description: Cold air rises from a section of floor that has dropped away along a long crack, and with it a smell of wet earth and lamp oil. Loose grit still trickles over the edge and ticks against something far below. A weak groan comes up after it. The rope from the last one is still in your pack, frayed where it ran over the edge.

Cold air rises from a section of floor that has dropped away along a long crack, and with it a smell of wet earth and lamp oil. Loose grit still trickles over the edge and ticks against something far below. A weak groan comes up after it. The last one like this stopped halfway through a breath.

Cold air rises from a section of floor that has dropped away along a long crack, and with it a smell of wet earth and lamp oil. Loose grit still trickles over the edge and ticks against something far below. A weak groan comes up after it. Whoever paid at the altar is the first to kneel at the edge.

Cold air rises from a section of floor that has dropped away along a long crack, and with it a smell of wet earth and lamp oil. Loose grit still trickles over the edge and ticks against something far below. A weak groan comes up after it. Whoever kept their hand closed at the altar stands at the edge with both hands in their sleeves.

name: Old Count
description: The air here is still and smells of wet chalk. Your torch finds the wall first: tally marks from knee height to as high as an arm can reach, hundreds of them, cut by one hand in rows as neat as stitching. Water has run down through the oldest. The last row stops mid-stroke.

crossEventVariants.description: The air here is still and smells of wet chalk. Your torch finds the wall first: tally marks from knee height to as high as an arm can reach, hundreds of them, cut by one hand in rows as neat as stitching. Water has run down through the oldest. The last row stops mid-stroke. Under it, a pack strap rotted through at the buckle.

chainEscalatedDescription: Tally marks, hundreds, in neat rows. Your eyes go to the floor under them first, for whatever was left behind.

reflection.prompt: On the way out, you glance back once at the half-finished mark.

options.curious: You count the last full row before you go.
options.wary: You keep to the far side of the corridor, away from the wall.
options.dismissive: You shoulder your pack and take the next corridor down.

name: Doubled Back
description: Dust lies even and grey across the floor, deep enough to hold a print sharp at the edges. Footprints lead into this room and stop in the middle. None lead back out. The room is empty to its corners.

crossEventVariants.description: Dust lies even and grey across the floor, deep enough to hold a print sharp at the edges. Footprints lead into this room and stop in the middle. None lead back out. The tread is worn down at the heel, like yours.

chainEscalatedDescription: Footprints lead into this room and stop. Your own walk straight to the spot where they end.

reflection.prompt: You check the walls for a door. The stone is solid all the way round.

options.curious: Your boot hovers over the last print, then steps around it.
options.wary: You leave the way you came, stepping in your own prints.
options.dismissive: You scuff the last prints flat with your boot and move on.

name: The Delay
description: Still water pools at the edge of the room, black and flat, and the only sound is a slow drip from the ceiling into a far corner. The surface holds the torchlight like polished glass. Your reflection catches up to you a half-second late, every time you move.

reflection.prompt: Somewhere behind you, water drips a beat after each step.

options.curious: You pass a hand over the water once more and count the delay.
options.wary: You keep your eyes forward the rest of the way down.
options.dismissive: You rub your eyes and keep walking.

name: Waiting Supplies
description: The corridor bends here, and in the dry angle of the bend, out of the draft, a bundle sits wrapped and tied at the base of the wall, where someone would leave it to come back for later. The cloth smells faintly of smoked meat. The rope is knotted tight, every turn laid the same way. Dust lies thick on the knot.

crossEventVariants.description: The corridor bends here, and in the dry angle of the bend, out of the draft, a bundle sits wrapped and tied at the base of the wall, where someone would leave it to come back for later. The cloth smells faintly of smoked meat. The rope is knotted in a spiral, the same mark burned into the merchant's goods. Dust lies thick on it.

chainEscalatedDescription: A bundle sits at the base of the wall. Your pack is already full of bundles tied the same way.

reflection.prompt: You took half the bundle and tied the rest up again, the way you found it.

options.curious: You tie their knot again from memory, on a strap of your own.
options.wary: You eat from your own rations tonight and leave their bundle tied.
options.dismissive: You cinch your pack shut over the extra rations.

name: Vigil
description: A candle burns at the end of a long, dusty corridor with no footprints in it, its light steady enough to read by. The wax has pooled thick on the floor and set in layers, like the rings of a cut tree, but the flame is a new candle's height. A cloth lies folded beside it.
chainEscalatedDescription: A candle burns at the end of an empty corridor. The cloth folded beside it would make a good bandage.

options.curious: You hold a hand near the flame. It's warm.
options.wary: Hands in your sleeves, well clear of the flame.
options.dismissive: Wax runs strangely sometimes. You leave it to burn.

name: Broken Seal
description: A stone hatch sits flush in the floor, mortared at the edges, its chain hanging torn and cold enough to fog the air around it. Half a spiral is stamped into what's left of the lock, the other half torn away with whatever broke it open.

crossEventVariants.description: A stone hatch sits flush in the floor, mortared at the edges, its chain hanging torn and cold enough to fog the air around it. Half a spiral is stamped into what's left of the lock, the other half torn away with whatever broke it open. Chips of mortar lie on the stone beneath it, fallen inward.

A stone hatch sits flush in the floor, mortared at the edges, its chain hanging torn and cold enough to fog the air around it. Half a spiral is stamped into what's left of the lock, the other half torn away with whatever broke it open. Chips of mortar are scattered across the floor, thrown outward.

chainEscalatedDescription: A stone hatch with a torn chain. Your pack is open on the floor before the torch is set down.

reflection.prompt: You keep your torch on the open hatch until you're out of the room.

options.curious: You look for scratch marks on the inside of the hatch.
options.wary: You give the torn chain a wide berth.
options.dismissive: Old damage. You step past the hatch and check your map for the stairs.

name: Half a Warning
description: Someone carved this fast, low on the wall where the stone is soft, and never finished it; the last letters trail off into scratches. A snapped knife blade lies in the grit below. What's left: 'saw what happened to the one who tried to carry both. I won't write what was left of them. Choose one side. Don't waver.'
chainEscalatedDescription: Words carved fast into the wall, unfinished. You read them on the way to the gear piled underneath.

reflection.prompt: The last stroke runs off the end of the word and down the wall.

options.curious: Twice you read the last word, then the blank after it.
options.wary: You read it once and walk on fast.
options.dismissive: Scratch marks on a wall. You've walked past a hundred.

name: Still Breathing
description: The walls curve inward like ribs here, and the air between them is warm and damp, drawn in and out of the room by a slow draft. Grown into one of them is a strip of old cloth with a mark burned into it, the same mark as on the goods you've traded for.

reflection.prompt: Outside the room, you check the seams of your own pack.

options.curious: You press a thumb against the wall. It gives, a little.
options.wary: You turn your marked goods face-in, at the bottom of the pack.
options.dismissive: You tug the pack straps tight and keep to the middle of the corridor.

name: The Wanderer
description: A figure sits with their back against the wall, beyond the reach of any light but yours, turning something small over in their hands, too dark to see what. Their boots are worn through at the toes. 'How long's it been?' they ask, not really to you. 'Feels shorter every time I ask.'
descriptionVariants: A figure leans against the far wall in a room that smells of cold ash, restringing a bow that has no string. Their fingers go through every turn of the knot, tight and patient. 'The quiet floors,' they say. 'Watch those.'
A figure on the bottom step looks up as you approach, lantern light sliding over a face streaked with dust. 'Not you, then,' they mutter, and sit back down facing the stairs.

crossEventVariants.description: A figure sits against the wall, turning something small over in their hands. They nod to you. You nod back and keep walking.

reflection.prompt: Whoever that was, they didn't ask your names, and you didn't offer them.

options.curious: The whole way down, you listen for an answering voice.
options.wary: You don't look back to check if they're still where you left them.
options.dismissive: You step around their boots and take the stairs.

name: The One Who Stayed
description: A small fire burns low at the edge of the torchlight, and the smoke smells of the same wood you burn. A figure crouches beside it in {{class}} gear, worn the way yours is, only longer. They look up without surprise. 'You got further than we did,' they say.

name: The Gatekeeper
description: Wind comes down off the hills and into the cave mouth, and none of it comes back out. An old man leans on a staff beside the opening, a lantern hung from its tip. The rock at the threshold is worn smooth at shoulder height, where hand after hand has steadied itself before going in. 'Most who pass leave something with me. Coin, by custom. Keep it if you like. The way in doesn't close.'
